what: Proposed telemetry calls use PLUGIN_ROOT in scripts that do not define it
scenario_or_breakage: Both scripts run under set -u; after a successful Codex run the new record_usage_from_events call would expand an unbound PLUGIN_ROOT and abort instead of completing the workflow
suggested_fix: Define PLUGIN_ROOT in both scripts using the launcher pattern PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd -P)}" before the telemetry call, and add regression coverage with CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset

what: The wrapped Codex JSONL conversion omits --output-last-message for the human result log
scenario_or_breakage: After dropping --capture-stdout, Codex stdout becomes JSONL and run-external-agent no longer writes codex.log or coder-codex.log; review-and-fix then copies an empty coder-output.log, so SKIPPED finding extraction and operator diagnostics silently disappear
suggested_fix: Add --output-last-message "$run_dir/codex.log" and --output-last-message "$round_dir/coder-codex.log" to the respective codex exec argv, then assert the result log remains non-empty and contains FIXED/APPLIED/SKIPPED-style content while JSONL stays in the events file

what: The direct Codex branch plan adds a post-run telemetry command without preserving the Codex exit status
scenario_or_breakage: The script currently captures EXIT_CODE from the case branch status; if external_launcher_record_usage_from_events runs after codex exec and returns 0, a failed Codex negotiation is reported as success with RESPONSE_FILE even when codex exited non-zero
suggested_fix: Capture codex_rc immediately after codex exec, run telemetry best-effort, then return or exit with codex_rc so the existing EXIT_CODE handling still sees the reviewer failure

what: The plan adds timing task kinds but does not add any timing-ledger emissions for the three sites
scenario_or_breakage: These direct/non-launcher sites would only write token-ledger usage records; lib-timing-kinds.md would claim scripts emit timing task kinds that are never passed to timing-ledger.sh, leaving dead allowlist entries and misleading docs
suggested_fix: Either add start/end capture plus timing-ledger.sh record-vendor-task calls for codex-lint-fix, codex-negotiation, and codex-review-fix, or remove the lib-timing-kinds changes and document these as token-ledger raw labels only
